result.effect: Introducing PGS generally lowered PPV; the exception was a maximum PGS-effectiveness condition with least-effective progress monitoring, where PPV increased by up to 3.9 percentage points.

cells.quote: Results from this model show that introducing PGS as a secondary method of being identiﬁed as at-risk lowered positive predictive while raising NPV for every situation except when PGS reached its theoretical limit and progress monitoring was at its least effective.
